subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2: Climate Change – Project: Reusable Shopping Bag
outcomes: Know the parts of a good bag design: slogan, image and material.
Design a reusable shopping bag with my team and explain it in English.
Give and receive feedback and reflect on our teamwork.

tf.s: A slogan is a short phrase on a bag.
tf.why: Yes! A good slogan is short and easy to remember.

tf.s: 'Material' means a picture on the bag.
tf.why: Material is what something is made of; the picture is the image.

tf.s: Reusable bags can be used many times.
tf.why: Correct, that is why they reduce plastic waste.

tf.s: Each bag in Activity 1 has an environmental message.
tf.why: Right, the designs send a message about the environment.

tf.s: A disposable bag is a bag you use many times.
tf.why: A disposable bag is used once; a reusable bag is used many times.

tf.s: In the team, the writer explains the design in words.
tf.why: Well done, the designer makes the illustration.

tf.s: Plastic bags are better for the environment than reusable bags.
Good feedback includes a positive comment and a suggestion.
tf.why: Yes, it helps the other team improve.

tf.s: Feedback only shows weaknesses, so it cannot improve a project.
tf.why: Feedback shows strengths and weaknesses, so the product improves.

tf.s: Communication is not important in a team project.
tf.why: Communication helps the team share roles and finish the work well.

boxes.q: A short phrase on a bag is a ...

boxes.why: Cloth is a material for bags.

boxes.q: A bag that can be used many times is ...
What message does a good reusable bag have?
Who designs the bag and the illustration?
boxes.why: The designer creates the look of the bag.

boxes.q: The ___ explains the design in words.

boxes.why: Each student chooses the best design.

boxes.q: Which is a polite suggestion for another team?
o: You could use a bigger slogan.

boxes.q: What are the three elements of the bag design?
boxes.why: The recording explains these three elements.

boxes.q: Which slogan suits an eco-friendly bag?
boxes.why: It sends a positive environmental message.

hunt.q: A short phrase on the bag
What the bag is made of

o: a short phrase with a message

mcq.q: What does a designer do in the team?
o: designs the bag and the illustration
mcq.why: The designer is in charge of the look.

mcq.q: What is an illustration in this project?
o: a drawing that shows the bag design
a vote for the best team
mcq.why: The team draws the bag to show its design.

mcq.q: Which word means 'what something is made of'?
mcq.why: For example, cloth is a material.

mcq.q: Your team needs a slogan for the bag. Which is best?
mcq.why: It is short and has an environmental message.

o: Our bag is made of cloth and has a picture of a turtle.
mcq.why: It names the material and the image correctly.

mcq.q: Which sentence describes your contribution to the project?
mcq.why: It says clearly what you did.

mcq.q: Why are reusable bags better than plastic bags?
o: They are made of plastic only.
mcq.why: Using one bag many times means less plastic.

mcq.q: How does feedback improve a project?
o: It shows strengths and weaknesses, so we can improve.
It makes the bag more expensive.
mcq.why: Feedback helps us see what to change.

mcq.q: Why is communication important in a team?
o: It helps coordinate roles and finish the work well.
It means only one person works.
It is not needed in English.
mcq.why: Good communication helps everyone work together.
